t: 2030 — First skin hulls districts certified: membrane facades assembly
title: 2030 — First skin hulls districts certified: membrane facades assembly
definition: 2030 milestone on the Breathing Building Skins roadmap.
description:
First skin hulls districts certified: membrane facades assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

What must be true first: the membrane facades results have to replicate outside the lab, skin logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and air exchange operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed membrane facades demonstrations, skin logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting air exchange uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Breathing Building Skins
definition: Estimates Breathing Building Skins readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Breathing Building Skins components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a skin hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Breathing Building Skins Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Breathing Building Skins operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Breathing Building Skins installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 13975 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where membrane facades monitoring, skin logistics redundancy, or air exchange maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Breathing Building Skins Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Breathing Building Skins: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Breathing Building Skins — facades that breathe like skin.

Phase 1 — Prove (membrane facades): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (skin logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (air exchange): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (moisture control): skin hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and buildings-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
